items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: He came to me, Andrew, and take my lessons on the sax. Really? Yeah, Andrew Morgan.

ctx.x: Yeah, that happens to a lot of you. I'm surprised that didn't happen to you. You know, like Harold Dajon, Andrew Morgan, John Handley, and I'm surprised.

Well Morgan got him attacked. He came to me, Andrew, and take my lessons on the sax. Really? Yeah, Andrew Morgan. Because he was fooling with the clarinet too. But everybody was enthused over it. Everything was Paul Barnes, Paul Barnes. They quit calling me Pullo. Oh they did?
